items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I could do Lena Horne and Ella... I can do Nellie Lutcher, Rose Murphy and a lot of them; Billie Holiday, especially.

ctx.x: Tell me about what you mean by being deleted.
Like if you’re in a movie, like if you play a Lena Horne and that, you can delete it for the South or for Southern audiences and the plot would not be disturbed.
So the MGM offer was before or after the United Artists?
